top_signals.title: Gold Rallies as Lower Yields, AI Stock Selloff Fuel Haven Demand
top_signals.summary: Gold increased as an equity selloff drove investors into bonds, pushing Treasury yields lower.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: IEA Agrees to Release of Outstanding 100 Million Oil Barrels
top_signals.summary: The International Energy Agency said that member countries agreed to complete the release of 100 million barrels of oil that are still outstanding from an intervention in March aimed at cooling high fuel prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Porsche CEO Leiters on New Luxury Supercar, China and EVs
top_signals.summary: Porsche AG unveiled a concept previewing a new supercar, the Mission S, that will be positioned above the 911 in its lineup. Speaking with Matt Miller on "Bloomberg The Close," Porsche CEO Michael Leiters discusses the new supercar and also comments on the state of the China market, the future of electric vehicles and the German automaker's storied legacy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
